urls.title: Document URLs
urls.description: Links to PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, CSV, TSV, HTML, TXT or Markdown files. Google Drive, Google Docs/Sheets/Slides, Dropbox, OneDrive/SharePoint, Box and GitHub share links are converted to direct downloads automatically (files must be shared as 'Anyone with the link').

keyValueStoreKeys.title: …or files in a key-value store
keyValueStoreKeys.description: Keys of files uploaded to an Apify key-value store. Use 'storeIdOrName/key', or just 'key' together with the store below (default: this run's store).

keyValueStoreId.title: Key-value store ID or name
keyValueStoreId.description: Store that holds the keys above.

datasetId.title: …or dataset with URLs
datasetId.description: Apify dataset (e.g. output of a crawler) whose items contain document URLs.

datasetUrlField.title: Dataset URL field
datasetUrlField.description: Field of the dataset items that holds the URL.

chunking.title: Chunking
enumTitles: By heading: one section per chunk (large sections split)
chunking.description: How to split documents into dataset items for embeddings / vector databases.

chunkSize.title: Chunk size
chunkSize.description: Maximum chunk size, in the unit below. Typical for embeddings: 300–1000 tokens.

chunkOverlap.title: Chunk overlap
chunkOverlap.description: How much text from the end of a chunk is repeated at the start of the next one (same unit). Max half of the chunk size.

includePageNumbers.title: Insert page markers
includePageNumbers.description: Adds <!-- page: N --> (Markdown) or [Page N] (text) at every page/slide boundary. Page ranges are always in each item's metadata.

ocr.title: OCR scanned pages
ocr.description: Read image-only (scanned) PDF pages and image files (PNG, JPG, TIFF, WebP) with OCR. Only pages without a text layer are OCR'd, and only those are charged as OCR pages.

ocrLanguages.title: OCR languages
ocrLanguages.description: Languages present in the scanned documents. Fewer languages = faster and more accurate.

maxPagesPerDocument.title: Max pages per document
maxPagesPerDocument.description: Process only the first N pages/slides of each document (0 = all). For formats without pages the text is cut at N × 3,000 characters.
